Supplementary Table 5 : Topology-level results for the discovered
superconducting routing policy using Gemini. SABRE, LightSABRE, and SimpleTES with Gemini costs are reported
as added SWAPs.
The reduction columns report the percentage decrease in Gemini added SWAPs
relative to the named baseline. The last row reports the unweighted mean over
the three topologies; its win/tie/loss entries are average counts per 24-case
topology.
